changelog:
- Added OLD-SKILL.md file for documentation/history purposes.
- Major update to SKILL.md: added a critical section on "Self-Discovery on Failure" to help users adapt to changing CLI commands/flags.
- Documented new global flags: `--results-only`, `--select`, `-n/--dry-run`, and more, with corresponding aliases.
- Added comprehensive sections for top-level and command group aliases to streamline command usage.
- Expanded user guidance for handling command and flag changes, promoting `--help` navigation and schema inspection.
- Retained existing feature documentation and improved explanations for usability.
summary: Google Workspace CLI for Gmail, Calendar, Chat, Classroom, Drive, Docs, Slides, Sheets, Forms, Apps Script, Contacts, Tasks, People, Admin, Groups, and Keep.
